description.value: A Kinder Cup is a community-focused café in Victoria built around a social mission: providing meaningful employment for people with developmental disabilities and multicultural backgrounds through their 'Kindness Ambassadors' team. They serve locally roasted Drumroaster Coffee from Cobble Hill alongside freshly baked goods, sandwiches, and a range of vegan and gluten-free options. Their Kindness Fund lets customers pay forward a coffee for someone else in the community.
